009913: // The expression shapes the enum-constant evaluator can apply sizeof or
009914: // _Alignof to without the type-parse machine: an object, parameter, local,
009915: // or enumerator name under redundant parentheses and leading dereferences,
009916: // extended by a postfix chain of subscripts and member selections. Anything
009917: // else stays unresolved and the caller fails the enumerator rather than
009918: // guessing â but these shapes cover the array-length idiom
009919: // `enum { N = sizeof(table) / sizeof(table[0]) }`, whose failure used to
009920: // fail the whole enum type and leave every one of its enumerators
009921: // undeclared in function bodies (found by tools/differential_c_harness.py,
009922: // family enum_sizeof; tests/basic_c_enum_sizeof_object.c is the fixture).
